title: Aina za nomino (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of wingi (maji, mafuta) are not counted and verbal nouns (kuimba) name an activity in KU-KU.

floor.question: Ni nomino ya wingi ipi: maji, jiwe?

steps: Is it counted? Is it an activity with ku-?
contexts: wildlife freedom (uhuru wa wanyama): kuwinda ni hatia

board.say: Hii ni nomino ya aina gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the sentence and one with a noun of wingi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi-jina kipi?" Kwa nini "mwimbaji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi-jina huanza kwa ku-, kama kuimba.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ya wingi?" Kwa nini "kiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maji ni nomino ya wingi; haina umoja.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno kusoma katika "Kusoma ni muhimu" ni nini?" Kwa nini "kitenzi kikuu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hapa kusoma ni jina la jambo, kwa hiyo ni kitenzi-jina.

misconceptions.ask: Nomino kuu ni kuimba au mwimbaji?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi-jina huchukua ku-: kuimba kwake kunapendeza.

checks.question: Ni kitenzi-jina kipi: mwindaji, kuwinda, aliwinda?
